method: Coordinator web_fetch inspected actual returned entries and headings. These paraphrased bounded observations are supplied evidence, not independent reviewer retrieval or whole-site endorsement. No raw copyrighted dictionary page copied into the runtime payload.

verified.observation: Young plants raised for cultivation; specifically rice seedlings. Encyclopedia sections distinguish woody 苗木 and describe propagation from seed, cuttings and grafting, so the teaching must not equate 苗 with an absolute seed-grown-only botanical category.
verified.limits: Other headings, etymological proposals and ethnonym history were not used as teaching claims.

headings: Digital Daijisen: なえ-しろ【苗代】
Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten: なわ-しろ【苗代】
verified.observation: The first points to なわしろ; the second explicitly identifies historical なは with なへ (苗), defines rice seedling growing beds and lists なえしろ as an alternative. Supports bound なわ- separately from full-word kana matching.
verified.limits: No claim that all rice cultivation uses a traditional nursery or that every nursery must remain flooded. Extended historical/agronomic sections are outside teaching scope.

headings: Digital Daijisen: しろ【代】, senses 4 and 5
verified.observation: Sense 4 concerns a part/place for a purpose; sense 5 specifically names a field and gives 苗代 as an example. The authored component explanation uses the narrower field/plot sense, not a price or era.
verified.limits: The first web_fetch result exceeded the tool's automatic output threshold; the saved actual output was then read at lines 1-75, which includes the complete Digital Daijisen しろ entry. No claim to reading the entire mixed 代 page.

headings: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten: くろ【畔・畦・壠】 and あぜ【畔・畦】
verified.observation: Raised boundaries between fields; あぜ entry also supplies the ridge between sliding-door grooves. Seisenban records regional distribution of くろ and あぜ. Public headword includes 畦/くろ, so JMdict's くろ restriction to 畔 is described as family-local, not a universal spelling prohibition.
verified.limits: Do not import every Jitsu historical sense or structural claim. Teaching retains a labelled modern-shape mnemonic.

headings: Digital Daijisen: せ【畝】, ほ【畝】, うね【畝／畦】
verified.observation: Distinct うね raised planting rows and surface ribs; Japanese せ is 30 tsubo / 99.174 square metres and differs from Chinese ほ. Nipponica additionally mentions ホ and ボウ in its Chinese land-measure discussion. Source-only ボウ means no ordinary lexical prompt established here, not no evidence of any use.
verified.limits: No universal conversion for historical Chinese measures, no invented numeral-plus-unit reading. JMdict's obsolete せ and rare ほ flags are attributed, not converted into claims that present-day recognition is unnecessary.

headings: Digital Daijisen: こ-はん【湖畔】, geographical entry
verified.observation: Side of a lake, with a walk-along-the-lakeside example. The same page begins with a separate painting-title entry, which was inspected but not mistaken for lexical geographic evidence.
verified.limits: No claim about a statistically measured register or frequency.

headings: 育苗 (いくびょう) / raising of seedling
verified.observation: Actual returned agricultural encyclopedia treatment concerns caring for seedlings and saplings, usually before transplanting, and mentions rice nurseries, growing facilities and forestry. Supports action versus growing place and no greenhouse-only restriction.
verified.limits: Leading section and the returned bounded treatment were inspected; no full-page acquisition hash or complete fresh multi-edition inspection claimed.

limits: Author evidence only. Not independent two-family review, native-speaker certification, phone comprehension testing or measured quiz safety. Frozen full JMdict packets remain the exact lexical-family record.
